title: Export
card-set: The whole set, as a card
note-webm: Saved as WebM: this browser has no H.264 encoder. Social networks want MP4 — use Chromium, or enable the OpenH264 plugin in Firefox (about:addons → Plugins), or convert: ffmpeg -i file.webm -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p file.mp4
note-notH264: Saved as MP4, but without H.264 (VP9/AV1): some networks refuse it. Use Chromium or enable OpenH264 in Firefox for H.264.
